beach-umbrella.context: A tilted beach umbrella stuck into the sand. Used for beach holidays, summer deals, seaside hotel amenities, sun protection tips and vacation booking filters.

binoculars.context: A pair of binoculars with two barrels joined at the middle. Appears on sightseeing and nature guides, viewpoint markers on maps, birdwatching apps and buttons that mean look closer or explore.

boarding-pass.context: A boarding pass showing a plane, flight details and a barcode. Used in airline apps, check-in screens, mobile wallet passes and trip itineraries.

camper.context: A camper van with a boxy living section behind the cab. Shows up in road trip planners, campsite listings, vehicle rental apps and RV park maps.

campfire.context: A flame burning over two crossed logs. Marks fire pits on campsite maps and is used for camping, outdoor cooking, bonfire nights and cosy or warmth themes.

camping-tent.context: An A-frame tent with its door open. Used for campsites on maps, outdoor gear shops, festival camping, glamping listings and hiking trip planners.

crosswalk.context: Zebra crossing stripes laid between two kerbs. Used on maps and navigation for pedestrian crossings, road safety content, walking routes and street accessibility info.

cruise.context: A cruise ship with stacked passenger decks and a funnel. Used for cruise bookings, ferry and sea travel, port guides, holiday packages and shore excursions.

currency-exchange-travel.context: Two coins with arrows that swap one for the other. Marks bureaux de change at airports and on maps, and is used for travel money, foreign cash and exchange rate tools in trip apps.

globe-earth.context: A globe drawn with a meridian and the equator. Used for language and region pickers, international shipping, worldwide availability, public web links and global settings.

gps.context: A satellite navigation unit on a mount with a direction arrow on its screen. Used for car navigation, turn-by-turn directions, route guidance and GPS tracking.

highway.context: A wide road with two dashed lane lines running into the distance. Used for motorway routes, avoid-highways settings in navigation, road trips, traffic reports and transport maps.

hostel.context: A house with bunk beds inside. Used for hostels and budget stays in booking sites, dormitory rooms, backpacker guides and student housing.

island.context: A small island with a palm tree, surrounded by water. Used for tropical holidays, island destinations, beach getaways and remote or isolated places.

luggage.context: A travel case with a carry handle and two straps. Used for baggage allowance, luggage storage, lost baggage, packing lists and hotel bag drop services.

map.context: An open paper map with a route leading to a marked spot. Used for directions, maps tabs in apps, route planning, store locators and treasure hunt style journeys.

map-folded.context: A paper map folded like an accordion into four panels. Used for travel guides, tourist maps, brochures, map views and open-map buttons.

milestone.context: A roadside milestone with a painted top and a carved line. Used for distance markers, progress checkpoints, project milestones, journey stages and historic routes.

mountain.context: A mountain range with one snow-capped peak. Used for hiking and ski destinations, outdoor apps, elevation and terrain views, and challenge or goal themes.

palm-tree.context: A palm tree with drooping fronds. Used for tropical destinations, beach holidays, summer themes, resort amenities and hot-weather content.

parking-meter.context: A parking meter standing on a post. Used for paid street parking, parking apps, pay-and-display zones, parking fees and city parking maps.

pin-drop.context: A map pin dropping onto a spot on the ground. Used for dropping a pin, setting or sharing a location, marking a place on a map and delivery addresses.

plane-ticket.context: A flight ticket with a small plane and a tear-off stub. Used for flight bookings, e-tickets, airfare deals, travel reservations and itinerary screens.

postcard-travel.context: A picture postcard with a sunset over the sea and a stamp in the corner. Used for holiday greetings, travel memories, sending postcards and destination photo galleries.

resort.context: A hotel block standing beside a palm tree. Used for holiday resorts, beach hotels, all-inclusive packages, spa stays and accommodation search results.

road.context: A road stretching into the distance with a dashed centre line. Used for routes, driving directions, road trips, journeys and roadmap or progress themes.

route-pins.context: Two map pins joined by a dashed route. Used for trip routes, start and end points, delivery tracking, directions from A to B and itinerary planning.

satellite.context: An orbiting satellite with two solar panels. Used for satellite view on maps, GPS and positioning, satellite internet, space themes and communications.

signpost.context: A signpost with two boards pointing in opposite directions. Used for directions, wayfinding, choices and decisions, help or guide sections and trail markers.

souvenir.context: A keyring with a heart tag attached. Used for souvenir and gift shops, travel keepsakes, merchandise, key fobs and memento themes.

street-sign.context: A street name plate mounted on a post. Used for street names, addresses, locations, neighbourhood guides and address search fields.

suitcase-rolling.context: An upright wheeled suitcase with a pull handle. Used for carry-on and cabin bags, trips and travel bookings, baggage rules, packing lists and hotel check-in.

sunrise.context: Half a sun rising over the horizon with an upward arrow. Used for sunrise times in weather apps, morning routines, alarms, dawn and early start schedules.

sunset.context: Half a sun sinking below the horizon with a downward arrow. Used for sunset times in weather apps, evenings, night mode schedules and end of day summaries.

toll-booth.context: A toll booth with its barrier arm raised. Used for toll roads, road charges, avoid-tolls settings in navigation, parking exits and checkpoints.

tour-bus.context: An open-top double-decker sightseeing bus. Used for city tours, hop-on hop-off services, excursions, group travel and tourist attractions.

traffic-light.context: A traffic light with red, amber and green lamps. Used for traffic signals on maps, status indicators, go or stop states, road safety and driving lessons.

travel-backpack.context: A hiking backpack with a sleeping mat rolled on top. Used for backpacking trips, hiking and trekking gear, outdoor shops and adventure travel.

visa.context: A travel document with an approval stamp on it. Used for visa applications, entry permits, immigration and border control steps, and travel document checklists.

world-map.context: A world map drawn as an oval projection with meridians and the equator. Used for global coverage, international offices, worldwide shipping, geography lessons and region selectors.
